p4_evidence.observation: G12 to G16 refinement changed the 140-160 cm bottom partition not at all; added resolution was in 0-80 and 100-140 cm.

B01.interpretation: Instantaneous flux error and reversal timing plateau while cumulative/storage errors continue to improve.

B14.interpretation: The G12 to G16 additions are effectively neutral for both Layer-ROM and same-partition Richards.

p4_evidence.inference_boundary: Because the same plateau occurs in conventional Richards, it cannot be assigned to CURRENT_LAYER_FACE. A minimal next test should target unresolved boundary-adjacent hydraulic shape rather than adding more upper-column storage states.

BASE16.bottom_gradient_estimator: Use retention-inverted mean heads of the final two G16 cells.

SPLIT17.description: Add one storage scalar by splitting only the bottom-most 157.5-160 cm cell at 158.75 cm.
SPLIT17.bottom_gradient_estimator: Use retention-inverted mean heads of the two 1.25-cm half cells.

HM17.description: Keep G16 storages and add one pressure-head first-moment scalar within 157.5-160 cm.
HM17.moment_definition: Least-squares linear pressure-head slope g_h = integral((d-c) h(d) dd) / integral((d-c)^2 dd), c=158.75 cm.
HM17.bottom_gradient_estimator: Use g_h directly as the within-bottom-cell pressure-head gradient.

common_flux_reconstruction.BASE16_K_rep: K evaluated from mean water content of 157.5-160 cm.
common_flux_reconstruction.SPLIT17_K_rep: K evaluated from mean water content of 158.75-160 cm.
common_flux_reconstruction.HM17_K_rep: K evaluated from mean water content of 157.5-160 cm.
common_flux_reconstruction.purpose: Compare information content, not create or admit a production flux closure.

decision_logic.STORAGE_SPLIT_SUPPORTED: SPLIT17 improves frozen flux metrics beyond numerical Reference uncertainty while HM17 does not materially outperform SPLIT17.
decision_logic.HYDRAULIC_SHAPE_SUPPORTED: HM17 improves frozen flux metrics beyond numerical Reference uncertainty and is componentwise better than BASE16; if it also outperforms SPLIT17, distinct hydraulic-shape information is supported.
decision_logic.BOTH_HELP: Both one-scalar augmentations improve beyond Reference uncertainty without componentwise dominance.
decision_logic.NEITHER_HELP: Neither augmentation improves beyond Reference uncertainty.
